title: AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic get_playback_position() always returns 0.0
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in 4.7.stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce 610M - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-3770S CPU @ 3.10GHz (8 threads) - 11.93 GiB memory - WASAPI (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic's get_playback_position() (which calls its superclass AudioStreamPlayback implementation) seems to always return 0.0 seconds.

Makes sense because it would need a stream id int to know which stream you were querrying in the first place.

Appologies if there is a way to get the playback position, but theres only so many methods implemented on this subclass so I think it's just not there yet.

Don't see how it could be a regression, but happy to test older versions if it's needed.

### Steps to reproduce

To reproduce: use AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.get_playback_position()

for example:

```python
extends Control

var player: AudioStreamPlayer

func _ready() -> void:
	player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	add_child(player)
	player.stream = AudioStreamPolyphonic.new()
	player.play()
	_run_test.call_deferred()
	
func _run_test() -> void:
	var playback: AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic = player.get_stream_playback()
	var wav_stream = load("res://laser-hit.wav")
	var stream_id = playback.play_stream(wav_stream)
	
	var unique_positions := {}
	var frame_count := 0
	while playback.is_stream_playing(stream_id):
		unique_positions[str(playback.get_playback_position())] = true
		frame_count += 1
		await get_tree().process_frame
		
	print("Frames tested: %d" % frame_count)
	print("Unique positions: %s" % unique_positions.keys())
```
